wavefunctions.phaseConvention: psi_nk(r) = sum_{i,T} c_i phi_i(r - R_i - T) exp(i k.T) (lattice gauge, sisl), sampled on the grid r = (i/N1) a1 + (j/N2) a2 + (l/N3) a3 of the home cell, C order [i][j][l]. It is the full Bloch function, so a neighbouring cell n = (n1,n2,n3) is obtained as psi(r + n.A) = psi(r) * exp(2*pi*i*(kfrac . n)). The global phase is fixed so that the largest-|psi| point is real and positive. Values = int8 * scale (Ang^-3/2); sum |psi|^2 dV over the home cell ~ 1.
